source_product: NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 v2.0 (2025), Native annual metric version 1
spread_meaning: Descriptive model spread conditional on one SSP; not event probability, scenario likelihood or a confidence interval.
regional_scope: Associated source-area cohort summary; not a full ecological or advocacy region climate mean. Unique source areas receive equal weight within each model before model quantiles. Regions overlap and are not additive.
realization_reason: Not retained in the provider annual table; no value inferred.
calendar_reason: Not retained in the provider annual table; no value inferred.
license: CC0 for Native and USGS prepared products
limitations: Source area is a statistical or administrative climate support, not a statement of sovereign territory.
Approximately 25 km NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 source resolution does not imply local detail for small areas.
Annual tables omit realization IDs and calendar names; these are unknown, not inferred.
Provider annual metrics ignore missing daily values; n_days counts rows, not valid observations. Daily valid-cell/day coverage is not supplied.
Equal-weight model spread is descriptive, not a confidence interval or scenario probability.
Annual pathways retain simulated interannual variability and are not year-specific weather forecasts.
Multi-area Nation ranges remain separate; no whole-Nation mean is inferred.
Annual precipitation change is in millimetres of mean annual total, not percent or rainfall intensity.
Positive-change model counts are model agreement, not calibrated probabilities.
These climate windows are separate from the scanner's risk-index projections and do not recalibrate them.
